name: Triodos Bank N.V.
summary: Triodos Bank N.V. provides retail, business, and private banking and financial products and services in the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, Spain, Belgium, and Germany. The company offers personal banking products and services, including mortgage, savings and current accounts, and investments products and services; and business banking services, such as current, fixed term, and savings accounts. It is also involved in investment management activities. Triodos Bank N.V. was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Driebergen-Rijsenburg, the Netherlands. Triodos Bank N.V. is a subsidiary of Stichting Administratiekantoor Aandelen Triodos Bank.
